Grand Academician of the Chongwen Hall Ren Huan was given Grandee of Splendid Happiness, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and overseer of the national history;

On jimao An Chonghui, Privy Council commissioner, Grandee of Splendid Happiness, honorary Grand Guardian, and acting Minister of War, was additionally granted Grand Preceptor of the Palace Gate, honorary Grand Mentor, and concurrently Palace Attendant;

On jimao An Chonghui, Privy Council commissioner, Grandee of Splendid Happiness, honorary Grand Guardian, and acting Minister of War, was additionally granted Kaifu Yitong Sansi, honorary Grand Mentor, and concurrently Palace Attendant;
開府儀同三司 is Kaifu Yitong Sansi, not Grand Preceptor of the Palace Gate; literal already correct.
In Tongguang Dou Lu'ge had renamed it to please Guo Chongtao's father's taboo Hong; now the old name returned.
In Tongguang, Dou Lu'ge had renamed it to please Guo Chongtao's father's taboo Hong; now the old name returned.
Idiomatic fuses reign era Tongguang with personal name Dou Lu'ge; insert comma after Tongguang.
On bingchen Mingzong ordered Duanming Hall scholars to rank above Hanlin and future appointees to come from Hanlin alone."
On bingchen Mingzong ordered Duanming Hall scholars to rank above Hanlin and future appointees to come from Hanlin alone.
Stray closing quotation mark with no opening quote in the idiomatic sentence.
Li Tong asked that local chiefs question prisoners every ten days and judge only after verifying charges, to curb wrongful convictions."
Li Tong asked that local chiefs question prisoners every ten days and judge only after verifying charges, to curb wrongful convictions.
Stray closing quotation mark; Chinese speech is summarized without matching open quote in idiomatic.

On dinghai Li Jilang, northern capital imperial-city commissioner, became senior general of the Dragon Martial Guard; Li Congzhen, northern capital overall commander, became senior general of the Left Guard; and Li Congcan, Pingsheng overall commander, became senior general of the Right Gate Guard.

On dinghai Li Jilang, northern capital imperial-city commissioner, became senior general of the Dragon Martial Guard; Li Congzhen, northern capital overall commander, became senior general of the Left Guard; and Li Congcan, Pengsheng overall commander, became senior general of the Right Gate Guard.
Chinese 捧聖 is Pengsheng (Holding-the-Sage), not Pingsheng.

On dinghai northern capital inner-city commissioner Li Jilang was made senior general of the Dragon Martial Guard; northern capital overall commander Li Congzhen was made senior general of the Left Guard; Pingsheng overall commander Li Congcan was made senior general of the Right Monitor Gate Guard.

On dinghai northern capital inner-city commissioner Li Jilang was made senior general of the Dragon Martial Guard; northern capital overall commander Li Congzhen was made senior general of the Left Guard; Pengsheng overall commander Li Congcan was made senior general of the Right Monitor Gate Guard.
Chinese 捧聖 is Pengsheng, not Pingsheng.

On wushen Censor-in-Chief Li Qi was made Right Vice Director; crown prince guest Li Ling was made Minister of Revenue; Vice Director of Rites Li Dexiu was made Minister of Rites; former Vice Director of Personnel Cui Yisun was made Vice Director of Personnel; Duanming Hall academician and Vice Director of Revenue Zhao Feng was made Vice Director of War, continuing in his former charge.

On wushen Censor-in-Chief Li Qi was made Right Vice Director; crown prince guest Li Ling was made Minister of Revenue; Vice Director of Personnel Li Dexiu was made Minister of Rites; former Vice Director of Personnel Cui Yisun was made Vice Director of Personnel; Duanming Hall academician and Vice Director of Revenue Zhao Feng was made Vice Director of War, continuing in his former charge.
Chinese 吏部侍郎李德休 is Personnel Vice Director, not Rites; idiomatic already correct.
At the Festival Garden chancellors, privy commissioners, and capital commissioners presented cash and silk and asked for a banquet.
The Emperor visited the Festival Garden; chancellors, privy commissioners, and capital commissioners presented cash and silk and asked for a banquet.
Idiomatic omits the subject 幸 “the Emperor visited,” present in the Chinese and literal.
On jiazi Li Jingzhou became Suizhou Wuxin regent.
On jiayin Li Jingzhou became Suizhou Wuxin regent.
甲寅 is jiayin, not jiazi; both English fields misread the sexagenary day.
On jiazi Western River military vice commissioner Li Jingzhou was made Wuxin army regent at Suizhou.
On jiayin Western River military vice commissioner Li Jingzhou was made Wuxin army regent at Suizhou.
甲寅 is jiayin, not jiazi.
Zhao Guangfeng retired from grand preceptor to grand guardian and was enfeoffed Duke of Qi.
Zhao Guangfeng, already retired as Minister over the Masses, was allowed to retire as Grand Guardian and was enfeoffed Duke of Qi.
司徒致仕 is retired Situ, not “grand preceptor”; 可太保致仕 changes the retirement title.
On gengshen Kong Qing of Zelu became Heyang commissioner.
On gengshen former Zelu commissioner Kong Qing became Heyang commissioner.
Chinese text is missing the given name after 孔; English supplies Qing without marking the lacuna.
On jiazi Huo Yanwei of Qing became grand preceptor and minister-in-chief, and Li Congzhang became Ying commissioner.
On jiazi Huo Yanwei of Qing was given Grand Commandant by inspection and concurrent Minister-in-Chief, and Li Congzhang became Ying commissioner.
檢校太尉 is Grand Commandant by inspection, not grand preceptor.
An Shengtong held the cavalry still; he and Fang Zhiwen plotted, waited their chance, and had the mutineers roll armor and march south.
An Shentong held the cavalry still; he and Fang Zhiwen plotted, waited their chance, and had the mutineers roll armor and march south.
Romanization should match s0082 An Shentong for 安審通.
On dingyou Yang Pu of false Wu sent acting Right Weiwie Guard general Lei Xian with Dragon Boat Festival tribute.
On dingyou Yang Pu of false Wu sent acting Right Awesome Guard general Lei Xian with Dragon Boat Festival tribute.
Weiwie is a corrupted transcription of 威衛 (Awesome Guard).

On weishan Minister of Revenue Li Ling said: "Let officials from fourth rank up each recommend two magistrates and registrars and fifth-rank officials two clerks and sheriffs each, with reward and punishment shared by the recommender."

On yiwei Minister of Revenue Li Ling said: "Let officials from fourth rank up each recommend two magistrates and registrars and fifth-rank officials two clerks and sheriffs each, with reward and punishment shared by the recommender."
乙未 is yiwei, not weishan.

On bingshen Ma Yin—Celestial Strategies supreme general, Hunan commissioner, open-office equal to Three Excellencies, acting Grand Mentor, Defender of Master of Writing, and Prince of Chu—became Defender of Grand Mentor and Master of Writing and was enfeoffed Prince of Chu.

On bingshen Ma Yin—Celestial Strategies supreme general, Hunan commissioner, open-office equal to Three Excellencies, acting Grand Mentor, Defender of Master of Writing, and Prince of Chu—became Defender of Grand Mentor and Master of Writing and was enfeoffed King of Chu.
封楚國王 is King of the state of Chu, not a repeat of Prince of Chu (楚王).
Qizhou prefect Xi Fangye reported defeating Jingnan rebels and recovering the three gorge prefectures.
Kuizhou prefect Xi Fangye reported defeating Jingnan rebels and recovering the three gorge prefectures.
夔州 is Kuizhou, not Qizhou (齊州).
Qizhou prefect Xi Fangye memorialized that he had defeated Jingnan rebel troops and recovered the three prefectures within the gorges.
Kuizhou prefect Xi Fangye memorialized that he had defeated Jingnan rebel troops and recovered the three prefectures within the gorges.
夔州 is Kuizhou, not Qizhou.
On bingyin Qizhou was raised to Ningjiang army and Xi became its military commissioner.
On bingyin Kuizhou was raised to Ningjiang army and Xi became its military commissioner.
夔州 is Kuizhou, not Qizhou.

On bingyin, Kuizhou was elevated to Ningjiang army; Xi was made military commissioner.
夔州 is Kuizhou, not Qizhou.
On gengwu Li Jingzhou of Suizhou and Liu Zhongyin of Yanzhou were both formally appointed commissioners of their circuits.
On gengwu Li Jingzhou of Suizhou and Liu Zhongyin of Fuzhou were both formally appointed commissioners of their circuits.
鄜州 is Fuzhou; Yanzhou renders 兗州, not 鄜州.
On gengwu, Suizhou deputy regent Li Jingzhou and Yanzhou deputy regent Liu Zhongyin were both formally appointed military commissioners of their circuits.
On gengwu, Suizhou deputy regent Li Jingzhou and Fuzhou deputy regent Liu Zhongyin were both formally appointed military commissioners of their circuits.
鄜州 is Fuzhou, not Yanzhou.

On jiaxu Ren Yuan, Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, sought retirement and physicians outside the capital; an edict approved.
太子少保 is Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, not Defender of Crown Prince Junior Tutor.
On guimao Zhu Shouyin of Bianzhou gained concurrent Palace Attendant; Fu Xi of Yanzhou became acting Grand Marshal.
On guimao Zhu Shouyin of Bianzhou gained concurrent Palace Attendant; Fu Xi of Yunzhou became acting Grand Marshal.
鄆州 is Yunzhou; Yanzhou renders 兗州, not 鄆州.
On guimao, Bianzhou military commissioner Zhu Shouyin was made concurrent Palace Attendant; Yanzhou military commissioner Fu Xi was made acting Grand Marshal.
On guimao, Bianzhou military commissioner Zhu Shouyin was made concurrent Palace Attendant; Yunzhou military commissioner Fu Xi was made acting Grand Marshal.
鄆州 is Yunzhou, not Yanzhou.
On jiachen Prince Congrong married Liu Zhongyin of Yanzhou's daughter; that evening the wedding feast was held and officials congratulated in memorial.
On jiachen Prince Congrong married Liu Zhongyin of Fuzhou's daughter; that evening the wedding feast was held and officials congratulated in memorial.
鄜州 is Fuzhou; Yanzhou renders 兗州, not 鄜州.
On jiachen, Prince Congrong married Yanzhou military commissioner Liu Zhongyin's daughter; that evening the wedding feast was held and the hundred officials congratulated in memorial.
On jiachen, Prince Congrong married Fuzhou military commissioner Liu Zhongyin's daughter; that evening the wedding feast was held and the hundred officials congratulated in memorial.
鄜州 is Fuzhou, not Yanzhou.

Since worthy ministers have kept it tranquil, affairs are sound and the people rejoice in good years; the whole circuit ever more firmly hopes for an imperial visit—the matter is hard to refuse the multitude, and the plan is to save a journey to the provinces.

Since worthy ministers have kept it tranquil, affairs are sound and the people rejoice in good years; the whole circuit ever more firmly hopes for an imperial visit—the matter is hard to refuse the multitude, and the plan is to tour and inspect the provinces.
省方 means to inspect the regions, not to save a journey.
Zhu Shouyin of Bian reported capital commander Ma Yanqiao had plotted rebellion and was already executed.
Zhu Shouyin of Bian reported capital commander Ma Yanchao had plotted rebellion and was already executed.
Chinese 馬彥超 is Ma Yanchao (彥超); Yanqiao misreads 超 as qiao.
Bianzhou's Zhu Shouyin memorialized that the capital commander Ma Yanqiao had plotted rebellion and had already been executed.
Bianzhou's Zhu Shouyin memorialized that the capital commander Ma Yanchao had plotted rebellion and had already been executed.
Chinese 馬彥超 is Ma Yanchao; align literal with 彥超.

On bingshen Cizhou's Yao Zongzhi reported that on the twelfth palace envoy Wang Renhao arrived with orders that retired Grand Guardian Ren Yuan had been killed.
Chinese 藥縱之 is Yao Zongzhi; Zongshang misreads 之.

On bingwu Wang Yandan of Weiwu—acting Grand Commandant and Jian prefect—became co-equal councilor at Jian and deputy of Fengguo and Weiwu.
Chinese 王延亶 is Wang Yandan (亶 dǎn); Yanyin is wrong. 檢校太尉 is acting Grand Commandant/Marshal, not Grand Guardian.

On bingwu, Wang Yanyin, deputy military commissioner of Weiwu Army, acting Grand Guardian, and prefect of Jianzhou, was made co-equal councilor while remaining prefect of Jian; he was made deputy military commissioner of Fengguo Army and concurrently deputy military commissioner of Weiwu Army.

On bingwu, Wang Yandan, deputy military commissioner of Weiwu Army, acting Grand Commandant, and prefect of Jianzhou, was made co-equal councilor while remaining prefect of Jian; he was made deputy military commissioner of Fengguo Army and concurrently deputy military commissioner of Weiwu Army.
Align literal with 王延亶 (Yandan) and 檢校太尉 (Grand Commandant).
On yimao Huo Yanwei of Qing and Fu Xi of Yan came to court.
On yimao Huo Yanwei of Qing and Fu Xi of Yun came to court.
Chinese 鄆州 is Yunzhou; Yan mistranslates 鄆 as if it were 兗.
